description: A substance that destroys or inhibits replication of viruses.
terms.label: antiviral agent

description: Any compound that is able to prevent damage to the kidneys.
terms.label: renoprotective agent

description: A substance that kills or slows the growth of microorganisms, including bacteria, viruses, fungi and protozoans.
terms.label: antimicrobial agent

description: A substance (or active part thereof) that kills or slows the growth of bacteria.
terms.label: antibacterial agent

description: A substance used in the prophylaxis or therapy of infectious diseases.
terms.label: antiinfective agent

description: Antipsychotic drugs are agents that control agitated psychotic behaviour, alleviate acute psychotic states, reduce psychotic symptoms, and exert a quieting effect.
terms.label: antipsychotic agent

description: An agent capable of relieving pain without the loss of consciousness or without producing anaesthesia. In addition, analgesic is a role played by a compound which is exhibited by a capability to cause a reduction of pain symptoms.
terms.label: analgesic

description: A drug which lowers the blood glucose level.
terms.label: hypoglycemic agent

description: A drug that affects the rate or intensity of cardiac contraction, blood vessel diameter or blood volume.
terms.label: cardiovascular drug

description: A substance that inhibits or prevents the proliferation of neoplasms.
terms.label: antineoplastic agent

description: A drug used to prevent seizures or reduce their severity.
terms.label: anticonvulsant

description: Any drug used in the treatment of acute or chronic vascular hypertension regardless of pharmacological mechanism.
terms.label: antihypertensive agent

description: An agent that suppresses immune function by one of several mechanisms of action. Classical cytotoxic immunosuppressants act by inhibiting DNA synthesis. Others may act through activation of T-cells or by inhibiting the activation of helper cells. In addition, an immunosuppressive agent is a role played by a compound which is exhibited by a capability to diminish the extent and/or voracity of an immune response.
terms.label: immunosuppressive agent

description: An  antimicrobial agent that destroys fungi by suppressing their ability to grow or reproduce.
terms.label: antifungal agent

description: A substance used to lower plasma cholesterol levels.
terms.label: anticholesteremic drug

description: A drug used for its effects on the gastrointestinal system, e.g. controlling gastric acidity, regulating gastrointestinal motility and water flow, and improving digestion.
terms.label: gastrointestinal drug

description: Any compound that can be used for the treatment of neurodegenerative disorders.
terms.label: neuroprotective agent

description: An antiviral agent that destroys or inhibits the replication of the human immunodeficiency virus.
terms.label: anti-HIV agent

description: Any compound that has anti-inflammatory effects.
terms.label: anti-inflammatory agent

description: Any substance which is used to reduce or control weight.
terms.label: anti-obesity agent

description: Any mammalian metabolite produced during a metabolic reaction in a mouse (Mus musculus).
terms.label: mouse metabolite

description: Any fungal metabolite produced during a metabolic reaction in Baker's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae ).
terms.label: Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite

description: A drug which increases the blood glucose level.
terms.label: hyperglycemic agent

description: Any bacterial metabolite produced during a metabolic reaction in Escherichia coli.
terms.label: Escherichia coli metabolite

description: Any mammalian metabolite produced during a metabolic reaction in humans (Homo sapiens).
terms.label: human metabolite
